entries.observed: Native image shows dark cracked/scaly wood surface under a polishing cloth.
entries.rationale: At full resolution the char-like surface supports half-burnt wood; thumbnail concern is resolved.
entries.inspection: Full native image viewed using view_image.

entries.observed: One man is visibly boasting while a similar man beside him bows his head; both occupy one continuous meeting scene.
entries.rationale: Source requires the same boaster to lose courage. The image can read as two different people, so the transformation is unclear.
entries.recommended_action: Use separated before/after panels with the same person, rather than two simultaneous figures.
entries.inspection: Full native image viewed using view_image.

entries.observed: Moustached man on left claps while a separate bearded man on right takes the plate in one continuous scene.
entries.rationale: The literal reading has one actor arrive, clap and take the plate. Unmarked two-person collusion changes that relationship.
entries.recommended_action: Prefer separate sequential panels showing the same person distracting and taking the food; if retained as a broader analogy, explicitly identify the two-person scene as an imagined adaptation.
entries.inspection: Full native image viewed using view_image.

entries.observed: Broken deep round stone mortar with separate pestle, beside two people in a doorway.
entries.rationale: Final literal wording and explanation specify a household grinding slab. The vessel changes the central object although displaced anger remains recognisable.
entries.recommended_action: Replace the mortar/pestle with a visibly cracked flat grinding slab and its roller. Preserve the displaced-anger scene without adding an origin claim.
entries.inspection: Full native image viewed using view_image.
